title: Mixed-cup FieldOperations
statement: Fix the operations and fixed coordinate bridges of [def-sf-mixed-cup-field-coordinates]. For each finite-field inclusion define its operation comparison by conjugating the recorded SixFunctorCoefficientComparison supportAdjunction.left or directAdjunction.right [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] with the fixed source and target rational-operation bridges and recorded transition identifications. For the inclusion of a finite field into the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], conjugate the corresponding commonStageComparison with the source rational-operation bridge. Both support choices use the same recorded normalized operation datum. These definitions construct the isomorphisms as explicit composites, and do not select an isomorphism from mere existence. The recorded construction data used here is that of [def-sf-operation-stages].
